**Comparison summary:**
- **Panama_Disease** (Banana_Leaf_10.jpg): Extremely strong match — identical widespread golden yellowing with dark brown streaks on wilted leaves
- **Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka**: Discrete spots/lesions on mostly green leaves — doesn't match

The uniform golden-yellow coloration across entire leaves with dark streaking is the hallmark of **Panama Disease** (Fusarium wilt), which causes systemic vascular wilting and leaf yellowing. The first reference image was nearly identical to the test image.
